archetypes.name: dyn-timing-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Gate B apply timing depends on ledger row filtering across skill labels.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Gate B apply timing changes in the plan-review loop and tests. Verify that removing the vendor skill filter still preserves duplicate detection, round-window bounds, malformed-row handling, and idempotency. Pay special attention to whether mixed-skill vendor rows in a per-run timing ledger could create an unintended anchor. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
